description:
In this video, we break down the Ethical Hacker Salary in 2026 and why this career is growing so fast. Did you know companies actually pay professionals to hack their systems and find vulnerabilities before real attackers do?

With cybercrime expected to reach $10.5 trillion globally, ethical hackers are becoming one of the most in-demand roles in cybersecurity. In India, beginners can earn around ₹5 to ₹5.4 LPA, while experienced professionals can go up to ₹10–15 LPA or more. In the US, salaries range from $75,000 to $150,000 depending on experience.

Top companies like Microsoft, Cloudflare, and Palo Alto Networks are actively hiring ethical hackers to protect their systems. If you’re interested in cybersecurity, ethical hacking is a high-growth and high-paying career path to explore.
